nodes.title: Trial credit comes from money_config (default 0) and is applied once per workspace AND once per owner email (hashed), by a trigger on the wallet's first write; ledgered as wallet_topup kind 'trial_credit'
nodes.rationale: a per-workspace guard alone lets an owner close and re-create a workspace for a second trial; the grant table has no cascade and stores only a hash
nodes.reverse_if: the owner sets a trial policy that allows more than one trial per owner (e.g. per GSTIN, or per company)

nodes.title: wallet.credit is Vyakti-staff only (actor vp_success with an id), runs at once, audited with its reason, and idempotent on a caller key (e.g. a ticket id) scoped to the workspace; same key with another amount is refused
nodes.rationale: a staff credit has no approval card, so no kernel action id exists to key it on; a caller key gives the same once-only guarantee as the top-up's action-id key
nodes.reverse_if: staff credits move behind an approval (then key on the kernel action id, as wallet.topup does)

nodes.title: The money module words wallet blockers in campaigns' Explained shape (code wallet_short, amount needed, balance, fix wallet.topup 'Add money'); campaigns calls it from launchBlockers (need = one call's G9 hold), number.search (cheapest offer's monthly rent) and number.rent (refuses on an empty wallet)
nodes.rationale: walkthrough S6: the number flow stopped at 'Renting spends money' without naming the wallet; one wording source keeps launch, numbers and wallet.check consistent
nodes.reverse_if: the campaigns builder prefers to own the wording; then wallet.check stays the money side and campaigns stops importing blockers.ts

events.what: Money: staff credit path (idempotent, audited), trial credit at workspace creation (config default 0, once per owner), user-facing copy says Vyakti (walkthrough S3), wallet-aware launch and number blockers (S6). 8 new tests, each failing before the change.
